title: Express Middleware and Request Flow
summary: Use built-in middleware and trace how a request moves through parsing, routing, and response handling.

sketchBlocks.title: Middleware can inspect a request and pass control onward

tryItExercises.title: Trace requests before the route
tryItExercises.prompt: Add middleware that logs `${req.method} ${req.path}` and then calls `next()`. Keep `GET /api/status` working.
tryItExercises.hint: The middleware must hand control onward after logging.

help.concept: Middleware can perform shared request work before route handling, then continue the chain with `next()`.
help.hint_1: Register the middleware with the application before the route.
help.hint_2: Logging alone does not continue request processing.

sketchBlocks.title: Order matters when later handlers depend on middleware

tryItExercises.title: Prepare request context before a route
tryItExercises.prompt: Register `express.json()` before routes. Then add middleware that sets `req.apiName = "campus-api"`, calls `next()`, and lets `GET /api/about` return that value as JSON.
tryItExercises.hint: Anything the route depends on must be registered earlier in the middleware chain.

help.concept: Middleware registration order controls which request preparation is available to later route handlers.
help.hint_1: Place the built-in parser before the custom middleware and route.
help.hint_2: The custom middleware must set the request field before continuing.

quizDraft.title: Continue the middleware chain
quizDraft.prompt: A middleware function logs the request but does not send a response. What allows the matching route to run next?
quizDraft.hint: Choose the operation that transfers control to the next handler.

help.concept: Express middleware must either complete the response or continue the chain.
help.hint_1: The request should keep moving rather than end in this middleware.
help.hint_2: The needed operation is supplied as the third middleware argument.

quizDraft.title: Recognize middleware uses
quizDraft.prompt: Which two tasks fit the middleware role taught in this topic?
quizDraft.hint: Look for shared request preparation or observation that can happen before focused routes.

help.concept: Middleware is useful for cross-cutting request work that precedes route-specific logic.
help.hint_2: Another prepares request data for later handlers.

options: Log method and path for incoming requests.
Parse JSON bodies before routes that need them.
Replace every resource lookup with a new server process.
Change the API port separately for each request.

quizDraft.title: Complete the request-flow idea
quizDraft.prompt: Choose the word that describes why registration sequence matters.
quizDraft.hint: The missing word describes sequence, not data storage or network addressing.

help.concept: Express request flow follows middleware registration sequence.
help.hint_1: Think about which handler is registered first, second, and later.
help.hint_2: A later route cannot use preparation that has not run yet.

quizDraft.template: Express runs matching middleware in registration [blank1], so preparation must come before a route that depends on it.

quizDraft.title: Trace middleware into a route
quizDraft.prompt: Arrange the request flow used in the worked example.
quizDraft.hint: The route handler comes after middleware has passed control onward.

help.concept: Middleware is part of an ordered request-processing chain.
help.hint_2: The transfer of control occurs before the route can run.

tokens: Call next when work is complete
correctOrder: Call next when work is complete
